text_block_list.text:
Both King-san and I were defeated at the 
Takamatsunomiya Kinen... Even so, King-san 
held her head high. Saying that she had 
made the choice true to herself...!

And King told me to ignore what others 
think and 'take pride in who you are.'

"...Stay true to yourself without fear of 
getting hurt! To hold my head high in that 
same spirit, I've decided to take the 
stage at the Fan Appreciation Festival's 
talk show."

Yes, of course I am scared. But... I have 
someone by my side who tells me that I am 
not alone...!
